application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow increase in height from the approved application following planning permission 00248/520-530/P16 dated 26/05/2017 for erection of part fourth and fifth floor extension to create an additional four flats
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begun before 1 May 2021.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith Design & access statement, 008_EX_GA04-P1, 008_EX_GA05-P1, 008_EX_GA06-P1, 008_EX_GE01, 008_EX_GE02, 008_EX_GE03, 008_EX_GS01-P1, 008_S01-P1 Received: 23/11/2020; 008_GA04-P3 , 008_GA05-P4, 008_GA06-P4, 008_GE01-P5, 008_GE02-P5, 008_GE03-P5, 008_GS01-P3 Received: 10/03/2021; Design & Access Statement and Daylight & Sunlight report received 03/04/2017; Drawings: 862-DG-0S01, 0R01, 0001, 0401C, 0501C, XX02, XX03, XX04; 862-EX-0S01, 0R01, 0401, 0501, XX01, XX02, XX03, XX04 received 03/04/2017; Drawing 862-DG-XX01B received 26/05/2017 received and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are occupied
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, details for: (i). the provision of six additional and secure cycle spaces; and (ii). new bin/recycling stores, shall be implemented on site in line with approved planning permission 00248/520-530/P16(5,6) on 09/07/2018 and thereafter shall be made available for use at all times.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, details of the privacy screening shall be implemented as approved by planning permission 00248/520-530/P16(5,6) on 09/07/2018 and thereafter shall only be repaired or replaced in accordance with the agreed details.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, the four window panes on the eastern/flank elevation as shown on drawing no. 008_GE02-P5 shall be obscurely glazed up to a height of 1.7m above the floor of the room in which the window is installed and non-opening below this height, and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise in accordance with these requirements.

Condition : 8 - Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, the local planning authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of Blue Badge holders, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit.

Condition : 9 - Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, apartments 4.01 and 5.01 shall be laid out in strict accordance with that shown on drawing no's 008_GA04 & 008_GA05 and thereafter the kitchen shall remain in situ.
Condition : 11 - The car park to the rear of the building on site shall be accessible for servicing and delivery vehicles at all times.
